shortDescription: Medallion Bank NASDAQ:MBNKO announced the pricing of a public offering of 2.2M additional shares of its 9.00% Fixed-Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series G, at a liquidation preference of $25 per share, raising an aggregate $55M.The transaction represents a reopening of Medall…

children: of 2.2M additional shares of its 9.00% Fixed-Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series G, at a liquidation preference of $25 per share, raising an aggregate $55M.
The transaction represents a reopening of Medallion Bank's initial Series G Preferred Stock issuance from May 22, 2025.
Shares will trade on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the ticker symbol "MBNKO."
The underwriters have been granted a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 330K shares to cover over-allotments.
Upon completion, Medallion Bank will remain a wholly owned subsidiary of Medallion Financial Corp.

Dividends on the Series G shares are set at a fixed annual rate of 9.00% until July 1, 2030, then adjust to the five-year U.S. Treasury rate plus 4.94% per year. Payments are made quarterly on January 1, April 1, July 1, and October 1, starting October 1, 2026, with the first payment on January 1, 2027.

Medallion Bank intends to use the net proceeds for general corporate purposes, which may include redeeming some or all of its outstanding Senior Series E Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, subject to Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation approval.
The offering is expected to close on September 30, 2026.

title: Medallion Bank prices $55M reopening of Series G preferred stock offering
